It opens with a refined blend of rose, incense, and warm spices, creating an immediate sense of depth and sophistication. As it develops, the heart reveals smoky oud wrapped in patchouli and labdanum, adding intensity and character. The base settles into smooth sandalwood, amber, musk, and vanilla for a warm, elegant finish that lingers beautifully on the skin.

Bold yet balanced, Royal Oud is designed for those who appreciate deep, opulent fragrances with presence and longevity.

Top — Rose, Incense, Nutmeg
Heart — Oud, Patchouli, Labdanum
Base — Sandalwood, Amber, Musk, Vanilla

title: Sleep Pillow Spray | Roman Chamomile | 28 Botanical Extracts | anatomē
descriptionHtml:
Can't stay asleep?

Transform your bedtime environment with anatomē Roman Chamomile Sleep Pillow Spray, expertly blended to create a calming sleep sanctuary and support deeper, more restorative sleep.

Developed using the principles of aromachology—the science of how scent influences the mind and emotions—this luxurious botanical pillow mist combines Roman Chamomile with 28 expertly blended botanical extracts, including Cornish Lavender, Dalmatian Sage, Rose Absolute Maroc, Blue Tansy, Clary Sage and Melissa, to help calm the senses and prepare both mind and bedroom for rest.

Unlike a room fragrance, this fine mist is designed specifically for pillows, bedding and sleep linens. As the botanical aroma gently surrounds your sleep environment, it creates a consistent sensory experience that encourages the mind and body to associate the fragrance with relaxation and sleep. With regular nightly use, it becomes an essential part of your evening wind-down ritual.

Why it works

At the heart of the formulation is Roman Chamomile, prized for its soft, comforting aroma and long valued for promoting relaxation before bedtime.

The blend is enriched with 28 botanical extracts, including Cornish Lavender, Dalmatian Sage, Rose Absolute Maroc, Blue Tansy, Clary Sage and Melissa. Together, they create a sophisticated aromatic profile designed to quiet the senses, ease feelings of restlessness and transform your bedroom into a calming sleep sanctuary.

A calming bedtime ritual

This is more than a pillow spray—it's a sensory bedtime ritual.

A light mist over your pillow, duvet and bed linen creates a calming botanical atmosphere that signals the end of the day. Inspired by the science of aromachology, the fragrance becomes a familiar sensory cue that helps prepare your mind for rest and relaxation night after night.

Whether you're looking to refresh your sleep space, create a calming bedtime ritual or enjoy the soothing aroma of Roman Chamomile before sleep, this expertly crafted botanical pillow spray helps transform your bedtime environment into a sanctuary of calm.

How to use

Lightly mist over your pillow, bed linen and sleep environment a few minutes before bedtime. Allow the botanical aroma to settle before getting into bed. Use nightly as part of your evening wind-down ritual for the most immersive sensory experience.
